question: How did each salesperson's annual total sales compare to their annual sales quota? Provide the difference between their total sales and the quota for each year, organized by salesperson and year.
sql:
-- Build the full comparison query
WITH sales_by_year AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(salespersonid AS BIGINT) AS businessentityid,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE)) AS sales_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(totaldue AS DOUBLE)) AS total_sales
    FROM salesorderheader
    WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL AND salespersonid != ''
    GROUP BY salespersonid, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(orderdate AS DATE))
),
quota_by_year AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(BusinessEntityID AS BIGINT) AS BusinessEntityID,
           EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE)) AS quota_year,
           SUM(TRY_CAST(SalesQuota AS DOUBLE)) AS total_quota
    FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
    GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(QuotaDate AS DATE))
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(s.businessentityid, q.BusinessEntityID) AS businessentityid,
    COALESCE(s.sales_year, q.quota_year) AS sales_year,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0), 2) AS total_sales,
    ROUND(COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) AS annual_quota,
    ROUND(COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0), 2) AS difference
FROM sales_by_year s
FULL OUTER JOIN quota_by_year q
    ON s.businessentityid = q.BusinessEntityID AND s.sales_year = q.quota_year
ORDER BY businessentityid, sales_year

SELECT
